Definition: accusative case of G5210; you (as the objective of a verb or preposition):--ye, you (+ -ward), your (+ own).
BiblicalUsage: hymâs is a plain word for you, ye, your. In Matthew 3:11, the text says "I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance."
TheologicalSignificance: Out of hymâs I do not force more than it gives: you, ye, your.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; Faith; Christian Life
RelatedEvents: The Baptism of Jesus; The Sermon on the Mount
